source_excerpt:
The extraordinary life story of notable Tourette Syndrome activist, John Davidson (played by BAFTA award winner Robert Aramayo). Set within 1980’s Britain, this emotionally engaging, funny and compelling film charts Davidson’s Tourette's diagnosis at the age of 14 and follows him throughout his life and explores this little known and entirely misunderstood condition.
